changes.before: गंतव्य डालने पर एक जैसी पढ़ाई वाले दो नाम आए। कौन चुनूँ समझ नहीं आता।
changes.after: गंतव्य डालने पर एक जैसे उच्चारण वाले दो नाम आए। कौन चुनूँ समझ नहीं आता।
changes.reason: 読み denotes pronunciation here, not studying.

changes.before: Tatanungin ko ang pasilidad sa estasyon at kukonsulta muli gamit ang screen na binago na sa balak na petsa.
changes.after: Tatanungin ko ang pasilidad tungkol sa pangalan ng estasyon at kukonsulta muli gamit ang screen na binago na sa balak na petsa.
changes.reason: Ask facility about station name, not ask facility at station.

changes.before: Hindi ko kusang bubuksan at hahatulan; ipasusuri ko kay tatay mismo ang abiso.
changes.after: Hindi ko ito bubuksan at pagpapasyahan nang walang pahintulot; ipasusuri ko kay tatay mismo ang abiso.
changes.reason: 判断 concerns deciding what to do with the notice, not judging a person.

changes.before: पहली बार आया हूँ। अपना जैसा नाम सुना लगा, लेकिन पक्का नहीं कि मुझे बुलाया।
changes.after: पहली बार आया हूँ। मुझे लगा कि मेरे नाम से मिलता-जुलता नाम पुकारा गया, लेकिन पक्का नहीं कि मुझे बुलाया गया था।
changes.reason: Use natural wording for uncertainty about hearing a similar name called.

changes.before: Nhân viên tiếp nhận sẽ xác nhận việc xử lý giấy tờ mang theo. Hôm nay anh/chị mang những gì?
changes.after: Nhân viên tiếp nhận sẽ xác nhận cách xử lý những đồ mang theo. Hôm nay anh/chị mang những gì?
changes.reason: 持ち物 is still general belongings here, not yet limited to documents.

changes.before: Titiyakin namin ang pinagkitaan at pag-iingat. Salamat sa pagdadala, ingat po sa pag-uwi.
changes.after: Titiyakin namin kung saan ito natagpuan at kung paano ninyo ito iningatan. Salamat sa pagdadala. Ingat po sa pag-uwi.
changes.reason: Replace pinagkitaan (earnings) with the place where badge was found.

changes.before: Chúng tôi sẽ xác nhận nơi tìm thấy và cách bảo quản. Cảm ơn anh/chị đã mang tới, chúc về cẩn thận.
changes.after: Chúng tôi sẽ xác nhận nơi tìm thấy và cách bảo quản. Cảm ơn anh/chị đã mang tới. Xin cẩn thận trên đường về.
changes.reason: Natural courteous departure phrasing without changing the found-property handover.

changes.before: শুধু সার্চ ফল থেকে সরকারি ডাকের ঠিকানা ঠিক না করে চুক্তির বিষয়ও ব্যবস্থাপককে জিজ্ঞেস করুন।
changes.after: শুধু সার্চের ফল দেখে সঠিক ডাক-ঠিকানা ঠিক করবেন না; চুক্তির তথ্যও ব্যবস্থাপকের কাছে যাচাই করুন।
changes.reason: 正式な送付先 means proper mailing destination, not government mail.

changes.before: अपुष्ट लिखावट सीधे इस्तेमाल किए बिना जानकारी व्यवस्थित करें। पुष्टि बाद आपकी सलाह की प्रतीक्षा है।
changes.after: अपुष्ट लिखावट सीधे इस्तेमाल न करें; पहले जानकारी व्यवस्थित कर लें। पुष्टि होने के बाद आप फिर सलाह लेने आएँ।
changes.reason: Preserve NPC offering future consultation rather than waiting to receive advice from player.

changes.before: Katakan akan menanyakan penulisan alamat agar surat sampai kepada pengelola sebelum mengisi. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.after: Katakan akan bertanya kepada perusahaan pengelola tentang cara menulis alamat agar surat sampai ke tujuan sebelum mengisi formulir. Sampaikan dalam bahasa Jepang.
changes.reason: Ask management company how to write the destination; mail is not to be sent to the manager.

changes.before: จัดข้อมูลให้ชัด ไม่ใช้การเขียนที่ยังไม่ยืนยันทั้งอย่างนั้นนะครับ รอรับคำปรึกษาหลังตรวจแล้วครับ
changes.after: กรุณาจัดข้อมูลให้ชัดเจน อย่าใช้ที่อยู่ในรูปแบบที่ยังไม่ได้ยืนยันทั้งอย่างนั้นนะครับ ยินดีให้คำปรึกษาหลังจากตรวจสอบแล้วครับ
changes.reason: NPC offers consultation after confirmation; it does not wait to receive advice.

changes.before: Nói dù tên sản phẩm giống nhau, thứ tự thành phần khác. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Nói dù tên sản phẩm gần giống nhau, thứ tự thành phần lại khác. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: Similar names are not identical names.

changes.before: Xin đừng kết luận cùng nội dung chỉ vì tên sản phẩm tương tự.
changes.after: Xin đừng kết luận thành phần bên trong giống nhau chỉ vì tên sản phẩm tương tự.
changes.reason: 内容 denotes product contents, not written content.

changes.before: ควรเผื่อใจด้วยว่าที่พักอาจไม่ได้เปิดให้ใช้เสมอ
changes.after: ควรเผื่อไว้ด้วยว่าจุดพักอาจไม่สามารถใช้งานได้เสมอ
changes.reason: Rest stop availability, not accommodation opening hours.

changes.before: स्वीकृति-संदेश है पर तारीख नहीं, फिर आवेदन करना है या नहीं पूछें। जापानी में कहें।
changes.after: कहें कि आवेदन मिलने की पुष्टि का संदेश आया है, लेकिन तारीख और समय नहीं हैं; पूछें कि क्या फिर से आवेदन करना चाहिए। जापानी में कहें।
changes.reason: Receipt acknowledgement is not approval or confirmed consultation.

reviewCriteria.criteria: Homophonous station options; address versus nearest station; confirm facility before buying; second of next month rather than today; return only with corrected information.
Unopened envelope addressed to father; no delegation yet; verify recipient first, do not infer deadlines from cover; only issuer/contact lookup before permission and detailed consultation.
First visit and similar called name; wrist pain began day before yesterday; belongings and identification suitability still unconfirmed; protect documents until correct recipient confirmed.
Found name badge; number meaning and owner unverified, do not call; five in evening before shop; protect name with paper in clear bag, no photo sharing; hand over whole bag and locate shop on map.

Map and contract differ in building name, map omits unit number; confirm deliverable address with manager, retain exact old address, two entrances are delivery information to consult about before application.

Name and address changes require separate confirmation; defer filling form; compare notice addressee with current document name privately; order, future notification destination and completion status remain to be confirmed.

Unopened versus after-opening storage instructions; find separate section on full package; compare smaller product independently, including ingredient ordering; similar product names never establish same contents.

Walking round trip energy budget; optional return before destination; marked rest stop not guaranteed available; older brother informed no promise to reach map edge; first rest stop used to reassess return capacity.

Delay ETA remains unconfirmed in simulated notice; low battery prevents repeated calls; agree next contact with family, paper phone number backup; check announcement hearing range before moving and ask counter with service name if partially missed.

Application receipt differs from schedule confirmation; separate scheduling notice expected; note reference number, ask unstated enquiry timing and preferred-date amendment through staff instead of duplicate submission; no promise amendment accepted.

storage: Additive receipt; previous receipt files retained byte-for-byte.
